name: tora_face
desc: brown paint tiger man, same image, same pose, body, colors and size. Only the face changes: the cheek fur is the same solid brown paint as the rest of the face, with darker brown tips; the snout is a plain smooth brown shape, the only dark line on it is its outline; the eyes are dull and murky, cloudy dark brown and matte; thick brown paint drips hang from the chin, jaw and cheeks and run down the neck.
